title: Carnitas Tacos
description: Pork shoulder cooked slowly in its own fat with orange and bay, then crisped hard under a broiler. Soft, rich, and shatteringly crisp in the same forkful.
notes: The crisping step is not optional. Braised pork alone is not carnitas.

ingredients.name: pork shoulder
ingredients.note: cut into large cubes, fat left on

steps.text: Put the pork shoulder in a heavy pot with the onion, garlic, bay leaves, cumin seed, and salt. Squeeze the orange over and drop both halves in.
steps.tip: The peel goes in too — the oils in it are half the point.

steps.text: Add water to come halfway up the meat and bring to a bare simmer.
Cook uncovered on the lowest heat until the water has gone and the pork is frying in its own rendered fat.
Lift the meat out, discard the bay, orange, onion, and garlic, and shred it coarsely with two forks.
Spread the shredded pork on a tray, spoon over some of the rendered fat, and broil until the edges are dark and crisp.
steps.tip: Do not stir it while it crisps, or you get steam instead of crust.

steps.text: Warm the corn tortillas, fill, and finish with cilantro.
